teams.detail: Snapped a five-game skid, beating Tampa Bay 8-2 Sunday as Randy Arozarena hit a three-run homer; SP Emerson Hancock left in the 2nd with a hand injury. Seattle improves to 48-49 and heads into the All-Star break (Tues 7/14, Citizens Bank Park); next up vs. the Giants after the break.

Beat Cleveland 103-94 in Summer League Sunday; Chaz Lanier (23 pts, 7-for-12 from three) and Brice Williams (21 pts) led the way, and No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie added 14 pts, 6 ast, 7 stl. Next: Monday 7/13, 4 PM ET vs. Knicks.

The Paul Allen Estate agreed to sell the franchise to a Khosla family-led group for a record $9.612B, pending ratification by at least 24 of the other 31 owners. Training camp opens July 25 in Renton with nine public practices; Football Fest is Aug. 8 at Lumen Field.

UW is still chasing a cornerback and two offensive linemen after landing Colorado transfer Reis Russell, while RB Jordan Washington continues to target a late-July return from his spring injury. Fall camp is the next major checkpoint before the 2026 opener.

F Hannes Steinbach (14th overall to Charlotte in June) remains the program's top NBA export. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo and is one of four finalists for 5-star guard Dylan Mingo, though recent reports have UConn out in front.

headlines.headline: Heat linked to Klay Thompson as Miami looks to surround Giannis with shooters after the blockbuster trade
headlines.detail: A week after Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from Milwaukee for Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis and three first-round picks, the Heat are now rumored to be pursuing Dallas's Klay Thompson via trade. Dallas is prioritizing a trade over a buyout for the 37-year-old, who's owed $17.4 million in the final year of his deal.

headlines.headline: Seahawks agree to record $9.612B sale to Khosla-led ownership group
headlines.detail: The Paul Allen Estate has agreed to sell the Seahawks to a group led by 49ers minority owner Vinod Khosla's family, with Neeru Khosla set to become controlling owner — roughly 50% above the prior NFL sale record, pending ratification from at least 24 of the league's other 31 owners.

headlines.headline: NFL denies Brendan Sorsby's supplemental draft bid after gambling scandal, leaving Texas Tech transfer with no path to 2026 football
headlines.detail: The NFL rejected Sorsby's petition to enter the supplemental draft after the NCAA ruled him ineligible for placing more than 9,000 bets totaling at least $90,000 on college and pro sports. He can't sign as a free agent this year and is locked out of competitive football until the 2027 draft.

headlines.headline: Pac-12 basketball officially relaunches as a nine-team league, anchored by Gonzaga
headlines.detail: The rebuilt Pac-12 became a functioning basketball conference again as of July 1, pairing holdovers Oregon State and Washington State with Gonzaga, Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State, Texas State and Utah State, completing a two-year rebuild after realignment gutted the league in 2023-24.
